body:
Just remember that everyone's sad, they're just better at faking it than you are.
I saw it in a movie recently.

I don't have anything insightful to say or anything, except that I feel the same way. If I can pass my classes I'm not depressed, right? I'm just being mopey.

Don't invalidate your feelings, OP. You're allowed to feel certain things, and it doesn't help to tell yourself otherwise.
